summary.text: Traci Gere is a Democratic state representative from Kennebunkport, Maine, who has represented District 134 since December 2022 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia lists her profession as executive.

paragraphs.text: She earned a B.A. in international relations from Brown University in 1986 and an M.B.A. from Boston University in 1994.

Gere's career experience includes owning Make It KPT and serving as its president, working as director of development of Maine MILL, as managing director of Digital Research, Inc., and as executive director of River Tree Arts.
She took office in the Maine House on December 6, 2022, and Ballotpedia lists the House Engrossed Bills Committee as her committee assignment for 2025-2026.
